criticisms: The phrase 'deep crustal (nearly 190 km off Alaska)' slightly conflates 'deep crustal' with 'deep subduction-zone' depth — 190 km is well below the crust — but this is a very minor technical imprecision that most readers won't notice.

The Risk Watch note that 'this pattern can sometimes precede a larger mainshock' could cause unnecessary public alarm without a stronger qualifier or context about base rates; a brief reassurance that swarms usually do not escalate would improve balance.
Emoji section markers (🔴, 🔵, 🟠, ⚪) are visually helpful but may not render correctly in all emergency management systems or plain-text email distributions.
